summary: Public projects created on 3 December 2025: 5 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Repositories cover agentic AI reporting and local infrastructure: an MCP example for long-form report generation, an MCP server for saving files to a NAS over NFS, and documentation for running local inference on AMD GPUs. Other work covers smart home Halacha, prompt experiments comparing speech cleanup approaches, and a dataset of captioned Israel photographs.

projects.name: All About MCP
projects.description: Example repository for agentic AI generated long form report generation

projects.name: AMD AI Server
projects.description: Local AI inference server for AMD GPU users

projects.name: Save To NAS MCP
projects.description: An MCP server for saving files and folders to a local NAS over NFS. Eliminates repetitive steps when transferring data to NAS storage.

projects.name: Smart Home Halacha
projects.description: Notebook on Halachic dimensions of smart home usage and Home Assistant

projects.name: Voice Cleanup Prompt Experiment
projects.description: Testing various permutations in system prompting for raw audio transcript cleanup and comparing multimodal ASR vs. the STT + LLM approach

projects.name: Israel Photos
projects.description: A collection of 369 photographs captured across Israel between 2024 and 2025, with LLM-generated captions and location annotations. The images are sourced from the photographer's Pexels gallery.
